general_information.Syllabus Name: Language Teaching Practice_Thực hành giảng dạy ngôn ngữ
general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Coaching,Presenting,Demonstration,Active learning,Cooperative Learning,Experiential learning methods,Project Based Training,Presentation,Practice
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 105 hours self-study (including assessment, projects and assignments preparation time)
general_information.Description: This course prepares English major students for successful teaching experience with theory and practice in classroom management through authentic teaching, provides students with opportunities to apply AI and other digital tools to optimize teaching and learning processes. Emphasis is placed on developing efficiency, accuracy, and personalized learning, as well as cultivating future-oriented pedagogical competencies. Teaching method: lectures + teaching performance + reflection
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Students are responsible to do all exercises, and assignments given by instructor in class or at home by the due dates - Use laptops in class only for learning purposes
general_information.Tools: (1) textbook (2) reference materials (3) AI tools: - To generate lesson ideas, and activities: ChatGPT / Claude / Copilot/Padlet AI - To design teaching slides and visual materials: Canva / Canva AI / Gamma / Tome AI / SlidesAI - To develop lesson plans, quizzes: Eduaide / MagicSchool / MagicForm AI/Gemini/ Perplexity AI / Consensus - To adapt readings and create gamified tasks: Diffit / Quizizz AI / Kahoot! AI / Quizlet AI - To generate short video clips for lesson content: Kaiber (4) Other digital tools
general_information.Note: Assessment scheme: 1) On-going assessment: - Teaching demonstration 1: 40% - Teaching demonstration 2: 40% - Oral feedback: 20% 2) Final result: 100% 3) Completion Criteria: Every teaching demonstration >3, & Final Result >=5/10

description: This course prepares English major students for successful teaching experience with theory and practice in classroom management through authentic teaching, provides students with opportunities to apply AI and other digital tools to optimize teaching and learning processes. Emphasis is placed on developing efficiency, accuracy, and personalized learning, as well as cultivating future-oriented pedagogical competencies. Teaching method: lectures + teaching performance + reflection

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Construct SMART ESL/EFL lesson outcomes to meet learners' needs
Integrate appropriate instructional strategies to meet an ESL/EFL lesson's outcomes
Design and generate pedagogically sound ESL/EFL lesson ideas through the effective use of AI and digital learning tools, ensuring alignment with specified lesson outcomes and curriculum standards.
Implement AI-supported instructional strategies that respond to learners’ linguistic backgrounds, individual needs, and affective factors such as motivation and language anxiety.
Critically evaluate the effectiveness of ESL/EFL lesson demonstrations by utilizing AI-assisted observation and reflection tools to identify pedagogical strengths and areas for enhancement.
Justify, through evidence-based reasoning, the influence of teacher behaviour and AI-supported classroom interactions on learners’ motivation and engagement.
Apply AI-driven assessment and feedback systems to monitor, analyse, and improve learner performance and language development in ESL/EFL contexts.
Demonstrate ethical awareness and professional responsibility in the use of AI technologies for language teaching, ensuring fairness, data privacy, and inclusivity in learning environments.

assessments.Question Type: Giving oral feedback on other pairs' demonstrations using the criteria in the teaching demonstration rubric

assessments.Grading Guide: Student teachers observe all demonstrations and take notes using the rubric. During the feedback sessions in class, teacher assigns which demonstrations each person should give feedback on.
